description: Search the CMS NPPES NPI registry for clinicians or organizations. Use for "find orthopedic surgeons in Colorado", "orthopaedic surgeons in ZIP 80303", verifying a practice name, or listing a taxonomy in a city. Returns NPI, name, credential, taxonomies with state licenses, addresses and secondary practice locations.

first_name.description: Given name of an individual provider

last_name.description: Family name of an individual provider

postal_code.description: 5-digit US ZIP code (or ZIP+4). Matches practice-location addresses, including secondary practice locations

taxonomy.description: Specialty as NPPES words it, e.g. "Orthopaedic Surgery" (British spelling)

name: find_providers
